strings.Bautismo de buceo: qué esperar antes de: Diving baptism: what to expect before entering the water | Nómada Extremo
strings.El instructor explica cómo respirar, cóm: The instructor explains how to breathe, how to compensate for your ears, how to empty the mask if water gets in, how to communicate with hand signals, and what to do if you feel uncomfortable.
strings.La entrada debe ser calmada. Primero se: The entrance must be calm. First, breathing and buoyancy are checked at shallow depths. Then you advance little by little, without rushing and with close contact with the instructor.
Need a few minutes to relax.
strings.No hay que demostrar nada. Si necesitas: You don't have to prove anything. If you need to stop, stop. The good instructor does not push the student: he accompanies, observes and decides.
Notice pressure in your ears when going down.
Feeling strange when breathing through the mouth.
strings.Texto divulgativo de proyecto académico: Informative text of a non-operational academic project. To really dive, go to an authorized center with qualified instructors and medical examination when appropriate.
strings.Un bautismo de buceo no es tirarse al ag: A baptism of diving is not jumping into the water with a bottle. It is a first guided, progressive experience designed so that you understand the basics before diving in.
strings.¿Es una primera experiencia o un curso?: Is this an introductory experience or a course?
strings.¿Qué ocurre si decido no continuar?: What happens if I decide not to continue?
